description: This file contains the ApiParameterHelper class, a utility class for extracting and processing query parameters from HTTP requests in the Fineract API. It provides static methods for parsing parameters like commandId, fields, associations, locale, and flags such as template, makerCheckerable, includeJson, and genericResultSet.

classes.name: ApiParameterHelper
classes.description: A final utility class providing static methods for handling API query parameters in the Fineract infrastructure.

methods.name: commandId
methods.description: Extracts the 'commandId' parameter from query parameters as a Long.

methods.name: extractFieldsForResponseIfProvided
methods.description: Returns a set of requested fields for response serialization if 'fields' parameter is provided.

methods.name: extractAssociationsForResponseIfProvided
methods.description: Returns a set of associations provided via 'associations' parameter for response, if present.

methods.name: excludeAssociationsForResponseIfProvided
methods.description: Removes specified associations from a set of fields based on 'exclude' parameter.

methods.name: extractLocale
methods.description: Parses and returns the Locale specified by 'locale' parameter.

methods.name: genericResultSetPassed
methods.description: Returns true if 'genericResultSet' parameter is present in query parameters.
